say.en: Oh! Someone new at the post! Good to have you here. I'm Bavko, the postmaster of the Sky Post.
say.sl: Oh! Nekdo nov na pošti! Lepo, da si tu. Sem Bavko, poštar Nebesne pošte.

say.en: Nobody carries the mail alone out here. Pick a creature to travel with you, then come back for your first delivery.
say.sl: Tu nihče ne nosi pošte sam. Izberi bitje, ki bo potovalo s tabo, nato se vrni po prvo pošiljko.

say.en: I have a note for Tobolko, down by the meadow. Can you take it to him?
say.sl: Imam sporočilo za Tobolka, tam pri travniku. Mu ga lahko neseš?

say.en: I'll take it!
say.sl: Prevzamem!

say.en: Later.
say.sl: Kasneje.

say.en: Wonderful! Here's the note. Tobolko is by the meadow, west of here.
say.sl: Odlično! Tu je sporočilo. Tobolko je pri travniku, zahodno od tod.

say.en: No hurry. The letters can wait.
say.sl: Ni treba hiteti. Pisma lahko počakajo.

say.en: Tobolko is waiting for that note. He's by the meadow.
say.sl: Tobolko čaka na tisto sporočilo. Najdeš ga pri travniku.

say.en: The shrine's old bell cracked in the last big gust. I have a new one. Will you take it to Mehurka?
say.sl: Stari zvonec v svetišču je počil v zadnjem močnem sunku vetra. Imam novega. Ga odneseš Mehurki?

say.en: I'll take it!
say.sl: Prevzamem!

say.en: Later.
say.sl: Kasneje.

say.en: Thank you! Mehurka keeps the shrine, just east of here. Careful, the bell rings at every step.
say.sl: Hvala! Mehurka skrbi za svetišče, malo vzhodno od tod. Previdno, zvonec zazvoni ob vsakem koraku.

say.en: Mehurka is waiting for her bell. The shrine is just east of here.
say.sl: Mehurka čaka na zvonec. Svetišče je malo vzhodno od tod.

say.en: Mehurka says a rest at the shrine works wonders. Give it a try.
say.sl: Mehurka pravi, da počitek v svetišču dela čudeže. Poskusi.

say.en: Vetrinka at the east lookout asked for this wind gauge. It shows how strong the wind is. Will you take it?
say.sl: Vetrinka pri vzhodnem razgledišču je prosila za ta vetromer. Kaže, kako močno piha veter. Ga odneseš?

say.en: I'll take it!
say.sl: Prevzamem!

say.en: Later.
say.sl: Kasneje.

say.en: Good. Follow the path east until you feel the wind.
say.sl: Dobro. Pojdi po poti proti vzhodu, dokler ne začutiš vetra.

say.en: Vetrinka is at the east lookout. She knows the winds better than anyone.
say.sl: Vetrinka je pri vzhodnem razgledišču. Vetrove pozna bolje kot kdorkoli.

say.en: This came on the wind this morning. A grey envelope, all wet, and no sender.
say.sl: Tole je zjutraj prinesel veter. Sivo pismo, čisto mokro, brez pošiljatelja.

say.en: Vetrinka knows all about the weather. Maybe she can work this out too. Will you take it to her?
say.sl: Vetrinka ve vse o vremenu. Morda bo razumela tudi tole. Ji ga odneseš?

say.en: I'll take it!
say.sl: Prevzamem!

say.en: Later.
say.sl: Kasneje.

say.en: Thank you. Hurry, and watch out for the strong wind.
say.sl: Hvala. Pohiti in pazi, ker močno piha.

say.en: Any news about that grey letter? Vetrinka will know what to do.
say.sl: Kaj je novega s sivim pismom? Vetrinka bo vedela, kaj storiti.

say.en: The letter, back again? Let me look at it once more.
say.sl: Pismo je spet tu? Naj ga še enkrat pogledam.

say.en: Wait. It's addressed to... you. "To the new courier."
say.sl: Počakaj. Naslovljeno je na ... tebe. »Za novi obraz na Nebesni pošti.«

say.en: To be continued…
say.sl: Se nadaljuje …

say.en: That letter found you before you found it. Whatever is out there, the Sky Post is with you.
say.sl: Tisto pismo je našlo tebe, ne ti njega. Kar koli je tam zunaj, Nebesna pošta je s tabo.

say.en: Tobolko was asking for you. He's by the meadow, west of here.
say.sl: Tobolko te je iskal. Je pri travniku, zahodno od tod.

say.en: The wind is gentle today. Good weather for letters.
say.sl: Veter je danes nežen. Pravo vreme za pisma.

say.en: This is the job board, where odd jobs pile up. Do any you like! Finish one and a new one appears.
say.sl: To je oglasna deska, kjer se nabirajo priložnostna dela. Opravi katero koli! Ko eno končaš, se pojavi novo.

say.en: Finish any job from the board. Its reward comes to you at once.
say.sl: Opravi katero koli delo z deske. Nagrado dobiš takoj.

say.en: Just what the post needed! Thank you, thank you.
say.sl: Prav to je pošta potrebovala! Hvala, hvala.

say.en: A job for me on the board? Wonderful. Bring it all once you have it. I'll try not to forget!
say.sl: Delo zame z deske? Čudovito. Prinesi vse, ko zbereš. Potrudil se bom, da ne pozabim!
